reason: RF_VARIANTS preserves raw separator flags, but EXPOSED_PARAGRAPHS word arrays do not encode all ZL/IT flags. More fundamentally, ZL/IT/RF are alternate readings of one manuscript, so cross-reader agreement cannot be independent semantic evidence. No semantic experiment was run; the original proposal is preserved.

blockers.detail: Invariant order across alternate transcriptions is expected from a shared source. Raw RF boundaries can audit transcription, but cannot by themselves identify a shared content role or meaning.

all_of.detail: A within-reader, raw-boundary-conditioned change in neighboring form/argument configuration must recur at a second locus against an explicit orthographic whole-phrase null; reader agreement alone is insufficient. No such independent semantic consequence is currently supplied. This is a design requirement, not proof that a reopening gate is met. Hypothetical joint meanings are allowed; no confirmed anchor is required.

not_sufficient: More similar strings, reader agreement or random-word rivals alone
A matching change label or evidence-file existence
